page.notes: Greek characters in the table and in the running text are transcribed approximately; the scan is faint and several accents and breathings are uncertain. Lines of Greek in the Cratinus quotation are only partly legible and are marked here by "..." for the unreadable part, which is a fault against the transcription rules. The bottom-right word "Quot" is a catchword. The "Γ" heading is a Greek letter and is kept as printed. Long s is written as s throughout.
